links.outcome: ChatGPT diagnostic accuracy when input reports came from neuroradiologists versus general radiologists
links.effect: Final diagnosis accuracy 82% (neuroradiologist reports) vs 52% (general radiologist reports), p=0.012; differential diagnosis accuracy stable at 96% vs 91%, p=0.33.
links.quote: ChatGPT’s final diagnostic accuracy using reports from neuroradiologists was higher at 82% (95% CI: 71, 89%), compared to 52% (95% CI: 33, 71%) using those from general radiologists with a p-value of 0.012.

screen.reason: Empirical study comparing ChatGPT's diagnostic performance against radiologists using retrospective real-world brain MRI reports, but does not test an organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
